chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Abi Hamzah, said:
I said to one of the two of them, peace be upon them: “Is the shroud of the deceased loosened?” He said: “Yes, and his face is uncovered.”

key_terms.كَفَنُ: the burial shroud used for the deceased

ai.seo_question: Should the shroud of the deceased be loosened and the face uncovered?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the treatment of the deceased at the time of death preparation. It indicates that the shroud may be loosened and the face of the deceased uncovered, reflecting funerary etiquette in Shia fiqh.
